evals.name: readme-art-contract
evals.prompt: We learned README skill images should sit below each install command, render at width 480, and stop hooks should block missing images. Convert that into deterministic behavior.
evals.expected_output: The response extracts inspectable invariants, updates or creates a README/art validator, keeps image generation separate from structural validation, and wires the shared check into hooks and CI with exit code 2 for policy failures.

assertions.text: Identifies README placement and width as validator-friendly invariants
Keeps hook and CI behavior delegated to one shared script
Uses exit code 2 for deterministic policy failures when matching the repository convention

evals.name: generated-art-boundary
evals.prompt: Nano Banana art varies creatively. Make the generation as deterministic as possible without pretending the pixels are fully predictable.
evals.expected_output: The response preserves a prompt harness, normalizes generated rasters, validates deterministic properties such as dimensions, path, file type, byte size, and prompt drift, and leaves subjective visual taste as review guidance.

assertions.text: Separates creative generation from deterministic post-generation checks
Recommends normalizers such as metadata stripping and fixed dimensions before validation

evals.name: subjective-no-trigger
evals.prompt: Brainstorm whether this interface feels premium and emotionally resonant.
evals.expected_output: The response does not force a deterministic validator. It asks for measurable acceptance criteria or keeps the work as subjective review guidance.

assertions.text: Declines to convert subjective taste into a hard gate without measurable criteria

evals.name: choose-reference
evals.prompt: I need to decide whether a repeated agent mistake should become a validator, normalizer, fixture, manifest, or CI check.
evals.expected_output: The response loads conversion-patterns for artifact selection and verification for proof depth, then chooses the lowest-freedom artifact that enforces the stable invariant.

assertions.text: Uses references/verification.md for proof ladder and cross-platform checks

evals.name: runtime-drift
evals.prompt: A GitHub Actions matrix is flaky because one runner lacks a Node flag that works locally. Turn that lesson into deterministic behavior.
evals.expected_output: The response recommends runtime pinning or feature detection, a preflight version check, a fixture or smoke test for the flag, and a shared CI/local validation command.

assertions.text: Treats runtime support as an environment invariant to probe or pin
Keeps local and GitHub Actions checks on the same core command
